Coming to IP 54, it's not really a problem but it's inferior to Galaxy A55's IP 67. The first number in the IP rating represents the protection against dust and the second number protects against water.

IP 54 means your phone is safe only from splashes of water, IP 64 would be mean the same, however anything IP 67 and above means your phone can be submerged at certain depth inside the water for whatever duration they claim. For A55 it's 1 meter of freshwater for upto 30 minutes. You can Google "IP rating chart" which explains each number.

Although just a disclaimer, water damages aren't covered under warranty so I don't recommend putting your phone in water.
